contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VALEN S PF AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Valens (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed draped right. Obverse inscription: DN VALEN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. OF in left field, uncertain character right field. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.1mm, Weight: 2.36gms, die axis: 6
